clinical_coding_review_table.triggering_criteria: Current case is outside prior CPT global period, or user reports no global-period context.
clinical_coding_review_table.user_facing_recommendation: No postoperative global modifier indicated; standard NCCI/MPPR logic continues.
clinical_coding_review_table.confidence_level_logic: High when dates/code allow calculation outside global; otherwise Low if missing required fields.
clinical_coding_review_table.known_payer_risk_denial_risk_language: Avoids unnecessary postop modifier. Still requires payer-specific review.

clinical_coding_review_table.triggering_criteria: In global period plus documented planned/staged operation, more extensive procedure, or therapy after diagnostic procedure.
clinical_coding_review_table.user_facing_recommendation: Recommended Modifier -58; staged/related procedure; begins new global period.
clinical_coding_review_table.confidence_level_logic: High when global-period calculation and at least one 58 criterion are documented; Low if dates/code missing.
clinical_coding_review_table.known_payer_risk_denial_risk_language: Risk if used for a complication return to OR, or if staged intent is not documented.

clinical_coding_review_table.triggering_criteria: In global period plus documented unplanned return to OR/procedure room for related complication.
clinical_coding_review_table.user_facing_recommendation: Recommended Modifier -78; unplanned related complication; does not begin new global period.
clinical_coding_review_table.confidence_level_logic: High when global-period calculation, return-to-OR status, related complication, and complication type are documented.
clinical_coding_review_table.known_payer_risk_denial_risk_language: Risk if the case is planned/staged, unrelated, or not clearly in OR/procedure-room setting.

clinical_coding_review_table.triggering_criteria: In global period plus documented unrelated procedure.
clinical_coding_review_table.user_facing_recommendation: Recommended Modifier -79; unrelated procedure; begins new global period.
clinical_coding_review_table.confidence_level_logic: High/Moderate when unrelated relationship and separate diagnosis/site/problem are documented; gap if unrelated rationale missing.
clinical_coding_review_table.known_payer_risk_denial_risk_language: Risk if diagnosis/site/problem is not distinct or payer considers the procedure related to prior surgery.

clinical_coding_review_table.triggering_criteria: Multiple objective unusual-work criteria, adhesiolysis >60 min, or operative time >150% expected.
clinical_coding_review_table.user_facing_recommendation: Possible Modifier 22 Candidate; surgeon review only.
clinical_coding_review_table.confidence_level_logic: High with 3+ objective criteria; Moderate with fewer but meaningful objective metrics; Low when objective support is absent/incomplete.
clinical_coding_review_table.known_payer_risk_denial_risk_language: High denial risk if documentation is subjective, unsupported, missing expected-time comparison, or payer rejects increased-work appeal.

deployment_recommendation_reason: The deterministic logic and regression gates are clean, but surgeon/coder review should approve or edit exact wording before production deployment, especially modifier 22 justification wording, expected-time comparison language, payer-risk language, modifier 78 wording, and modifier 79 documentation requirements.
